extension.summary: Populate missing metadata and artwork for existing library items.
extension.description: Library Updatarr scans your existing Kodi video library for movies, TV shows, and episodes with missing posters, fanart, or metadata. It applies local artwork and NFO files first, then uses your installed online scrapers to fill remaining gaps — without wiping the database or scanning for new files.

extension.summary: Github repository for Skippy - Video Segment Skipper for Kodi and companion Segment Editor
extension.description: Installs Skippy, Segment Editor and other Kodi addons

extension.summary: Edit EDL and chapter.xml segment files for videos during playback
extension.description: Allows you to edit segment files (.edl and chapter.xml) while watching videos. Supports adding, removing, and modifying segments. Can be triggered via keyboard shortcut, the context menu, or Kodi's NotifyAll JSON-RPC. If the video has embedded Matroska chapters, the editor offers to import them on first edit (requires mkvextract).

extension.summary: Automatically seeks back 1 second after 5 seconds of playback to fix subtitle display issues
extension.description:
This service add-on automatically waits 5 seconds after video playback starts, then seeks back 1 second to trigger subtitle re-synchronization. This fixes the common issue where embedded subtitles don't appear until manually seeking backward.
The add-on runs silently in the background and only activates when video playback begins. You can enable or disable it in the add-on settings.

extension.summary: Skippy: skip, mark, and edit video segments (intros, recaps, credits, and more) using local or online data.
extension.description: All-in-one Kodi companion for chapter-style workflows: automatically skip or prompt on segments, mark new ranges during playback, and open a full segment editor for .edl and Matroska-style chapters.xml sidecars. Configurable segment types (skip mode, aliases, EDL numbers), dialogs, and optional online lookups (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate keymaps for marker (skippy_marker.xml) and editor (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: spring over, markér og rediger videosegmenter (intro, resuméer, rulletekster og mere) med lokale eller online data.
extension.description: Alt-i-ét Kodi-ledsager til kapitelbaserede arbejdsgange: spring automatisk over eller spørg ved segmenter, markér nye intervaller under afspilning, og åbn en komplet segmenteditor til .edl- og Matroska-lignende chapters.xml-sidecarfiler. Konfigurerbare segmenttyper (springtilstand, aliasser, EDL-numre), dialoger og valgfri onlineopslag (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate tastaturtilknytninger til markør (skippy_marker.xml) og editor (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: sla videosegmenten (intro's, samenvattingen, aftiteling en meer) over, markeer en bewerk ze met lokale of online gegevens.
extension.description: Alles-in-één Kodi-hulpmiddel voor hoofdstukgebaseerde workflows: sla segmenten automatisch over of vraag erom, markeer tijdens het afspelen nieuwe bereiken en open een volledige segmenteditor voor .edl- en Matroska-achtige chapters.xml-sidecarbestanden. Instelbare segmenttypen (overslaan-modus, aliassen, EDL-nummers), dialogen en optionele online zoekopdrachten (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Aparte toetsenschema's voor markeerder (skippy_marker.xml) en editor (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy : passez, marquez et modifiez des segments vidéo (génériques d'intro, résumés, génériques de fin, etc.) à partir de données locales ou en ligne.
extension.description: Compagnon Kodi tout-en-un pour les flux de travail par chapitres : passez automatiquement les segments ou demandez confirmation, marquez de nouvelles plages pendant la lecture et ouvrez un éditeur de segments complet pour les fichiers annexes .edl et chapters.xml de type Matroska. Types de segments configurables (mode de saut, alias, numéros EDL), boîtes de dialogue et recherches en ligne facultatives (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Keymaps distincts pour le marqueur (skippy_marker.xml) et l'éditeur (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: Videosegmente (Intros, Rückblicke, Abspann und mehr) überspringen, markieren und bearbeiten – mit lokalen oder Online-Daten.
extension.description: Kodi-Komplettlösung für kapitelbasierte Abläufe: Segmente automatisch überspringen oder nachfragen, während der Wiedergabe neue Bereiche markieren und einen vollständigen Segment-Editor für .edl- und Matroska-artige chapters.xml-Sidecar-Dateien öffnen. Konfigurierbare Segmenttypen (Überspringmodus, Aliase, EDL-Nummern), Dialoge und optionale Online-Abfragen (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Getrennte Tastenbelegungen für Marker (skippy_marker.xml) und Editor (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: παράλειψη, επισήμανση και επεξεργασία τμημάτων βίντεο (εισαγωγές, ανακεφαλαιώσεις, τίτλοι τέλους και άλλα) με τοπικά ή διαδικτυακά δεδομένα.
extension.description: Ολοκληρωμένος βοηθός Kodi για ροές εργασίας βασισμένες σε κεφάλαια: αυτόματη παράλειψη τμημάτων ή ερώτηση, επισήμανση νέων διαστημάτων κατά την αναπαραγωγή και πλήρης επεξεργαστής τμημάτων για αρχεία sidecar .edl και chapters.xml τύπου Matroska. Ρυθμιζόμενοι τύποι τμημάτων (λειτουργία παράλειψης, ψευδώνυμα, αριθμοί EDL), διάλογοι και προαιρετικές διαδικτυακές αναζητήσεις (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Ξεχωριστές αντιστοιχίσεις πλήκτρων για τον δείκτη (skippy_marker.xml) και τον επεξεργαστή (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: salta, segna e modifica i segmenti video (intro, riassunti, titoli di coda e altro) usando dati locali o online.
extension.description: Compagno Kodi tutto in uno per i flussi di lavoro basati sui capitoli: salta automaticamente i segmenti o chiedi conferma, segna nuovi intervalli durante la riproduzione e apri un editor di segmenti completo per i file sidecar .edl e chapters.xml in stile Matroska. Tipi di segmento configurabili (modalità di salto, alias, numeri EDL), finestre di dialogo e ricerche online facoltative (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Mappature tasti separate per il marcatore (skippy_marker.xml) e l'editor (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: hopp over, marker og rediger videosegmenter (intro, oppsummeringer, rulletekster og mer) med lokale eller nettbaserte data.
extension.description: Alt-i-ett Kodi-følgesvenn for kapittelbaserte arbeidsflyter: hopp automatisk over segmenter eller spør, marker nye områder under avspilling, og åpne en full segmentredigerer for .edl- og Matroska-lignende chapters.xml-sidecar-filer. Konfigurerbare segmenttyper (hoppmodus, aliaser, EDL-numre), dialoger og valgfrie nettoppslag (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate tastetilordninger for markør (skippy_marker.xml) og redigerer (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: omite, marca y edita segmentos de vídeo (intros, resúmenes, créditos y más) con datos locales o en línea.
extension.description: Compañero todo en uno de Kodi para flujos de trabajo basados en capítulos: omite segmentos automáticamente o pregunta, marca nuevos intervalos durante la reproducción y abre un editor de segmentos completo para archivos sidecar .edl y chapters.xml de estilo Matroska. Tipos de segmento configurables (modo de salto, alias, números EDL), diálogos y búsquedas en línea opcionales (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Asignaciones de teclas independientes para el marcador (skippy_marker.xml) y el editor (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: hoppa över, markera och redigera videosegment (intron, sammanfattningar, eftertexter och mer) med lokala eller onlinedata.
extension.description: Allt-i-ett-följeslagare för Kodi för kapitelbaserade arbetsflöden: hoppa automatiskt över segment eller fråga, markera nya intervall under uppspelning och öppna en fullständig segmentredigerare för .edl- och Matroska-liknande chapters.xml-sidecarfiler. Konfigurerbara segmenttyper (hoppläge, alias, EDL-nummer), dialogrutor och valfria onlineuppslag (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separata tangentbindningar för markör (skippy_marker.xml) och redigerare (skippy_editor.xml).
extension.summary: Skippy: pule, marque e edite segmentos de vídeo (aberturas, recapitulações, créditos e mais) com dados locais ou online.
extension.description: Companheiro completo do Kodi para fluxos de trabalho baseados em capítulos: pule segmentos automaticamente ou pergunte, marque novos intervalos durante a reprodução e abra um editor de segmentos completo para arquivos sidecar .edl e chapters.xml no estilo Matroska. Tipos de segmento configuráveis (modo de pulo, apelidos, números EDL), diálogos e buscas online opcionais (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Mapas de teclas separados para o marcador (skippy_marker.xml) e o editor (skippy_editor.xml).

extension.summary: Shows Jellyfin trickplay seek thumbnails during video scrubbing.
extension.description: Reads or generates Jellyfin trickplay sprite tiles alongside your media, crops preview frames with Pillow while you scrub, and shows them via skin window properties. Optional ffmpeg generator writes .trickplay sidecars; use Install preview tools for Pillow (preview) and ffmpeg (generation). Use Show addon status / Install skin snippet in settings (DialogSeekBar.xml for most skins; VideoFullScreen.xml for Bello). Generation/HDR requires ffmpeg, ffprobe, and optionally dovi_tool.
